feedback_lesson_tap.name: feedback_lesson_tap
feedback_lesson_tap.value: case when "feedback"."kind" in ('lesson_helped', 'lesson_not_helped') then "feedback"."item_id" is not null and "feedback"."text" is null else "feedback"."item_id" is null end

parent_rewards_target.name: parent_rewards_target
parent_rewards_target.value: ("parent_rewards"."target_kind" = 'reward' and "parent_rewards"."reward_id" is not null) or ("parent_rewards"."target_kind" = 'stat' and "parent_rewards"."stat" is not null and "parent_rewards"."at_least" >= 1) or ("parent_rewards"."target_kind" = 'date' and "parent_rewards"."target_date" is not null)
